Q9024.reason: The no-resist statute bars force used to resist arrest, but if the jury believes the suspect the nightstick beating was excessive force and the punch was privileged self-defense even though the arrest was lawful.

Q9025.reason: Zoning compliance is not a complete defense, and total blockage of an existing solar use that could be avoided by siting the house elsewhere can be an unreasonable private nuisance, so the categorical judgment for the neighbor should be reversed.

Q9027.reason: Civil law is the body of law that establishes rights between persons and supplies redress when those rights are violated; stare decisis is only the doctrine of following precedent.
